The '''T-289 Gas Grenade''' was a [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]. When detonated, each grenade released [[T-289 stun gas]], which caused disorientation, nausea, and vomiting. The gas was nonlethal, except in very large doses, and ineffective against targets wearing protective [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]].

The stun gas was useful against a wide range of alien species, although its effectiveness could vary depending on the target. While a [[Human/Legends|Human]] would go down quickly from T-289, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] could still get in a few good swipes before finally passing out.
